name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic's own coding agent CLI, wrapped behind the Agents Hub HTTP contract. Edits files in a local git repository, runs shell commands, and reports its own token usage and dollar cost on every run.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Model key Claude Code uses for its own completions. Read by the CLI itself, not by the hub.

env.name: CLAUDE_MODEL
env.description: Model passed to claude --model, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6. Defaults to whatever the installed CLI picks.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Anthropic API base URL, for a proxy or a compatible gateway. Read by the CLI itself.

env.name: CLAUDE_WORKDIR
env.description: Git repository Claude Code edits when a run does not name a workspace. Defaults to /work.
